---
name: Documentation improvement
about: Report unclear, missing, stale, or misleading documentation
labels: documentation
---

## Documentation location

Provide the file path and section heading, for example `README.md — Quick Start`.

## Problem

Explain what is unclear, missing, stale, or misleading. Include whether the issue affects English, Bahasa Indonesia, or both.

## Proposed wording or structure

Provide a concrete suggestion when possible. Do not paste private or proprietary content.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Command examples are copyable and verified.
- [ ] Implemented, verified, planned, proposed, and backlog status labels are accurate.
- [ ] Security and local-first limitations remain visible.
- [ ] English and Bahasa Indonesia sections remain consistent when both are affected.
